bea.basis_summary: BEA permits reproduction of website information unless otherwise stated and requests source attribution. Separate restrictions apply to its logo.
bea.review_method: Assistant source-content and publisher-policy review; not legal clearance or practitioner review.
bea.reviewed_scope: Two exact plain-text GDP news-release and statistical-table excerpts. No logo or third-party asset is included.

bls.basis_summary: BLS identifies its publications as public domain except previously copyrighted photographs and illustrations. Attribution is requested. Its emblem has separate restrictions.
bls.review_method: Assistant source-content and publisher-policy review; not legal clearance or practitioner review.
bls.reviewed_scope: Five exact plain-text employment and CPI release excerpts. No photographs, illustrations or emblem are included.

board.basis_summary: The Board permits copying and distribution of its website information unless otherwise indicated, with source citation requested. Separately attributed non-Board materials require their own permission; seals and logos have separate restrictions.
board.review_method: Assistant source-content and publisher-policy review; not legal clearance or practitioner review.
board.reviewed_scope: Two exact plain-text government statement excerpts: portfolio-fed-20230322 and h2b-fdic-joint. The latter was checked against the identical substantive text on the Board co-publication at https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20230312b.htm because the FDIC URL returned HTTP403. No logo, image, model code or separately attributed third-party expression is included. This review does not extend to Reserve Bank sites or other FDIC excerpts.

eia.basis_summary: EIA permits reuse of its information products with acknowledgment including publication date. Privately contributed or licensed materials and photographs may have separate rights; its logo is restricted.
eia.review_method: Assistant source-content and publisher-policy review; not legal clearance or practitioner review.
eia.reviewed_scope: Six exact plain-text storage or petroleum statistical excerpts, notes and release index. The natural-gas excerpts omit market-price and analyst-survey sections. No photographs, logos or separately attributed data are included.

sec.basis_summary: The SEC Website Dissemination policy permits copying and further distribution without SEC permission and encourages citation. The SEC Webmaster FAQ separately addresses reuse. Seals, logos, artwork and trademarks have distinct restrictions.
sec.review_method: Assistant source-content and publisher-policy review; not legal clearance or practitioner review.
sec.reviewed_scope: Five exact plain-text SEC-created excerpts: exp-vistra-2023-index, systematic-apple-index, systematic-lyft-original-index, systematic-nvidia-index and systematic-sec-time-faq. These contain filing-detail metadata, factual document-list rows or SEC staff FAQ prose, with no linked issuer narrative, contract or image bytes. The FAQ policy evidence is https://www.sec.gov/files/about/webmaster-faq.htm. This review does not approve issuer-authored filings or exhibits merely because SEC hosts them.
